notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
